[ASSISTANT_SAID] Maintaining strong bones is crucial for our overall health, and two essential nutrients play a vital role in this process: vitamin D and calcium.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Vitamin D helps our bodies absorb calcium, which is necessary for bone growth and development.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Calcium gives our teeth and bones their structure.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] These nutrients are important at every stage of life.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Getting enough vitamin D and calcium can help prevent osteoporosis and reduce the risk of bone fractures as we age.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The daily recommended intake varies by age: If you are under 50, aim for 1,000 mg of calcium and 200 IUs of vitamin D.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] If you are over 50, you should aim for 1,200 mg of calcium and 400-600 IUs of vitamin D.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Foods rich in calcium include milk, cheese, yogurt, broccoli, kale, and almonds.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Foods rich in vitamin D include fatty fish (such as salmon and mackerel), egg yolks, mushrooms, and fortified foods (such as cereal and orange juice).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Incorporate these foods into your diet to keep your bones strong and healthy!
